title: Reply envelope, contract v1alpha1
description: The JSON form of every response message of machinery.plugin.v1alpha1.PluginService, with ok true, and of the Failure detail of a failed call, decoded, with ok false, data null and warnings saying why: exactly this object, every field written. The Connect code goes with a failure (plugin.proto).

data.description: The verb's result; its schema depends on the verb (describe.schema.json, fact-refresh.schema.json, or the referenced report schema for Merge).

notRead.description: Inputs the plugin was given and deliberately did not use, each with the reason.
